client_req_id.description: A unique identifier generated and sent by the client for the exit request. Refer Client Request Identifier for further details.

type.description:
Indicates the type of attribute used to identify the validators to exit. The possible values are,
- 1 (pubkey)
- 2 (validator_index)
- 3 (withdrawal_address)

items.description:
List of validator public keys to be exited. 
This is required if the exit type is 1. 
A maximum of 250 public keys can be specified.

The list of validator indexes to be exited. 
Required if exit type is 2. 
A maximum of 250 validator indexes can be specified.

withdrawal_address.description:
The withdrawal address of the validators that should be exited.
Required if exit type is 3

validator_count.description:
Required if exit type is 3. 
The Max count should be 250.
